rejected.headline: Indiantown Flooding Persists Despite $2M Booker Park Drainage Project

lead_independence.headline: Indiantown Flooding Persists Despite $2M Booker Park Drainage Project
lead_independence.lead: Flooding returned to Indiantown streets last week after heavy rain, and residents are bracing for more water as additional rain and storms are forecast this week. Vehicles were seen driving through standing water on village roadways, renewing frustration over a drainage and roadway project in Booker Park that has cost more than $2
